November 19, 2026

Trump's CISA nominee declines to call January 6 an attack in confirmation hearing

tags: politics, government
sources: @aaronparnas

At a Senate confirmation hearing, President Trump's nominee to lead the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency was repeatedly asked whether the January 6, 2021 events at the Capitol constituted an attack. The nominee first said he did not know, then said he did not believe it was an attack, and said he had not been involved in politics at the time. Pressed on his fitness to serve as an arbiter of government ethics, he said that if confirmed he would evaluate matters before him fairly and impartially regardless of the individuals or administration involved.
